text:
jake_s: quick heads-up, I ran a quick quant sweep for nebula13b across H100 (us-west) and A100 (eu-west). compared fp16, bf16, int8 (per-channel) and fp8(E4M3). p50/p95/p99 + throughput + small qa evals. attaching notes below. :eyes:

sara_ml: amazing, curious about fp8 numerical stability. did you see any token-level spikes?

jake_s: fp8 E4M3 stable on most prompts, but one prompt set with long numeric tables spiked perplexity ~+4% vs bf16. int8 gave biggest speedup but slight drop in rouge on summarization (~1.1 pts).

priya_onboard: numbers? p50/p95/throughput?

jake_s: paste of the quick table (median of 5 runs):

```
model: nebula13b
batch=2 (prefill+1 decode)
region | gpu  | quant   | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | tps(tokens/s) | rougeL delta vs bf16
us-west | H100 | bf16    | 62      | 180     | 310     | 7,800         | 0.0
us-west | H100 | fp16    | 60      | 170     | 300     | 8,100         | -0.1
us-west | H100 | int8    | 54      | 150     | 280     | 9,100         | -1.1
us-west | H100 | fp8(E4M3)| 50     | 145     | 275     | 9,600         | -0.9

eu-west | A100 | bf16    | 78      | 220     | 380     | 6,400         | 0.0
eu-west | A100 | fp16    | 76      | 210     | 365     | 6,700         | -0.2
eu-west | A100 | int8    | 68      | 190     | 350     | 7,500         | -1.4
eu-west | A100 | fp8(E4M3)| 66     | 185     | 340     | 7,900         | -1.0
```

jake_s: notably p99 improved on H100 more than A100, likely kernel selection + fused attention path.

matt_infra: what kernels did you pick? fallback to generic GEMM or custom fused kernels?

jake_s: used runtime default (auto-kernel). for fp8 on H100 it picked fused_attention_v2 + int8_gemm_accum where available. On A100 it used matmul_direct kernels more often. need to force kernel to compare.

sara_ml: can you run one forced-kernel comparison? e.g., force matmul_direct on H100 and fused_attention_v2 on A100 to isolate kernel vs hw diff.

jake_s: yea doing that next. quick note on quality: int8 quantization used symmetric per-channel with 8-bit rounding; we saw heavier regressions on QA and summarization but chat instruction-case less affected. fp8 seems middle ground (big speedups, smaller quality delta).

priya_onboard: did you try enabling kv-prefix caching in the config? that changes prefill cost a lot and might change p95 patterns.

jake_s: tests were with cache warm for decode (we run prefill then decode). I also ran cold-cache for a subset: cold-cache p95 jumps ~+40% for int8 on A100, less so on H100. suggests kernel memory access pattern matters for cache misses.

matt_infra: good call. Also check batch=8 throughput for capacity planning, and measure token-per-gpu-hour so we can price dedicated capacity.

jake_s: batch=8 quick numbers (fp8 on H100): throughput ~31k tokens/s, sustained 24k after memory pressure. will add full runs to S3.

sara_ml: please include the eval prompt set and failure examples for the +4% perplexity spike. that helps decide if we can accept fp8 for prod.

jake_s: yup exporting eval artifacts. early observation: fp8 failures were numeric-table extraction prompts — plan is to try per-layer fp16 fallback for first 2 transformer blocks.

priya_onboard: thumbs up. can you add a short rollout plan: canary percentage, monitor signals (rouge, perplexity, p99 tail) + auto-fallback to bf16?

jake_s: propose canary 5% traffic on H100 us-west, monitor p95/p99, rougeL on sampled prompts, and auto-fallback on >2% regression over 1h window. will draft in GH PR.

eval-bot: regression-scan: sample-evals found delta: rougeL -0.92 (fp8 vs bf16) over 200 eval prompts, p-value 0.03. alert level: advisory.

sara_ml: thanks. let's hold fp8 for non-critical inference (background batch jobs) until we can mitigate the table-numeric case. int8 still too risky for chat-prod.

jake_s: agreed. next actions: forced-kernel runs, batch=8 stable run for 30m, per-layer fp16 fallback experiment, and upload artifacts + run detailed evals. filing bench ticket now. :spiral_note_pad:
